anterior mediastinal mass
Reed–Sternberg–like cells

candidates.name: Non-Hodgkin lymphoma
support_spans: multiple enlarged lymph nodes
cohesive sheets of large pleomorphic cells
contradict_spans: strong CD30 positivity in the large and Reed–Sternberg–like cells
candidates.why: The presence of large pleomorphic cells and multiple enlarged lymph nodes could suggest Non-Hodgkin lymphoma, but the specific immunohistochemical staining pattern is more indicative of Hodgkin lymphoma.

candidates.name: Anaplastic large cell lymphoma
support_spans: large pleomorphic cells with abundant cytoplasm
kidney-shaped nuclei
contradict_spans: negativity for CD15, CD3, CD20, ALK, CD45Ro, and EMA
candidates.why: The presence of large pleomorphic cells with kidney-shaped nuclei could suggest Anaplastic large cell lymphoma, but the negativity for certain markers and the presence of Reed–Sternberg–like cells make Hodgkin lymphoma a more likely diagnosis.
